text:
opsbot: ALERT: region=eu-west-2 service=route-dns heartbeat missing for 3x probe intervals. auto-escalation threshold crossed. ticket=INC-20260315-443

jordan: saw this. paging now. I got a partial Route53 503 spike in prod from EU region? anyone seeing customer errors? :rotating_light:

elaine: support seeing increased 5xx from EU users. ~30 reports in the last 5m, mostly chat/send requests timing out then retrying to another region. Customers on Dedicated may see elevated latency.

jordan: copying mitigation checklist: 1) verify telemetry vs control plane, 2) check DNS healthchecks + route53, 3) confirm if it's a monitoring probe failure or real routing problem, 4) if unclear, failover traffic via routing policy.

mike: looking at telemetry. interesting: our monitoring probe row for eu-west-2 shows zeros for the last 10m but backend request rates look normal on instances that are still reporting. possible broken probe emitter.

ryan: from network: no large fabric events in EU region from cloud provider page. I can query R53 healthchecks:```bash
aws route53 get-health-check --health-check-id hchk-0a12bb34
# returns: HealthCheckObservations: [ ]
```
(this emptiness lines up with the probe not sending observations)

jordan: opsbot, any automated fallback triggered?

opsbot: Fallbacks: NOT_TRIGGERED. Routing policy is still using eu-west-2 primary for a subset of endpoints. Auto-fallback requires two consecutive failed health checks; current state is "no-observations" which doesn't count as fail.

mike: logs from the emitter pod show recent crashloop at 2026-03-15T10:02:01Z then restart; post-restart no outbound connections to stats endpoint. snippet:```log
[2026-03-15T10:01:58Z] probe-emitter main: initializing
[2026-03-15T10:02:01Z] probe-emitter error: TLS handshake failed for collector.internal:443 -> handshake timeout
[2026-03-15T10:02:02Z] kubelet: restarting container (CrashLoopBackOff)
[2026-03-15T10:06:12Z] probe-emitter main: running, but queued=0, sent=0
```

elaine: support: some customers called saying retries got routed to NA and worked, but a small set (VPN / coloc) still hit errors. would mark customer impact as partial degradation for EU.

jordan: good note — severity: P2 (partial regional degradation). I'm going to trigger controlled fallback for affected services and add an annotation so we can roll it back quickly if wrong. anyone object?

ryan: +1 if we can limit to non-dedicated tenants. For Dedicated customers we need org approval.

anna: FYI CS: I emailed top 5 EU Dedicated customers as heads up; they asked for rollback visibility and ETA.

mike: plan: 1) restart probe-emitter daemonset across eu-west-2 (graceful), 2) temporarily mark healthchecks failing for probes that remain silent so routing will failover, 3) monitor errors and rollback if more issues.

jordan: go ahead restart step 1. use runbook snippet:```bash
kubectl rollout restart ds/probe-emitter -n monitoring --context=eu-west-2
# watch pods
kubectl get pods -l app=probe-emitter -n monitoring -w
```

ryan: I'll prepare a Route53 change but won't flip global TTL yet. If probe restarts restore observations we'll hold.

mike: restart completed. I see new observations starting at 10:12:30Z but counts are low. opsbot: observations seen -> 1 of 3 intervals.

opsbot: NOTE: automated rollback window is 30m after manual override. No fallback applied yet.

elaine: customer reports dropping from 30 -> 8 affected. good trend.

jordan: given partial recovery but continued gaps, I'm going to mark non-dedicated routing for eu-west-2 as passive and allow route53 weighted fallback to increase weight for eu-west-1 by 80% for 10m. ryan please execute.

ryan: executing change (commented for audit): "temporary weight shift eu-west-2 -> eu-west-1 to mitigate missing probe observations". Change ID: CHG-20260315-789.

opsbot: ROUTING CHANGE: CHG-20260315-789 applied. New weights: eu-west-2=20, eu-west-1=80. TTL honored.

mike: monitoring: request errors in EU dropped ~75% within 2m. but some Dedicated customers still see increased latency due to sticky routing. we need to coordinate targeted fix for them.

anna: CS: two Dedicated customers asked for dedicated failover. I told them we're evaluating and will update in 15m.

jordan: summary for handoff: root cause likely probe-emitter TLS handshake regression after cert rotation caused local emitter to stop reporting observations (false-negative monitoring). impact: partial EU degradation (P2), automated fallback didn't trigger because "no-observations" != failures. mitigation: restarted emitters, shifted route53 weights for non-dedicated traffic, contacted Dedicated customers. next actions for next oncall: follow up with cert rotation job, verify emitter library bump in next deploy, confirm permanent fix so that no-observations is treated safely.

mike: adding runbook note to ticket INC-20260315-443: treat "no-observations" as suspect and surface to SRE tools.

jordan: handing off to mike, who takes primary until 11:00Z. I'll be on standby. 

mike: acknowledged. I'll monitor for 30m then update incident status and create a postmortem draft. :spiral_notepad:

opsbot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: INC-20260315-443 status=mitigated temporary_routing in_place owner=mike

elaine: thanks team. customers alerted and CS has two follow-ups.

anna: leaving note: cherrypick of probe fix requested by Dedicated customers.

jordan: thanks all — handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
